title: Jonah and the Ember
author: Isandro Whitlock
blurb: Astrid Kavanagh, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
